title: Clinical Assessment of Oxiconazole Nitrate Solid Lipid Nanoparticles Loaded Gel
brief_summary: Clinical study for the developed oxiconazole nitrate solid lipid nanoparticles (SLNs) gel system compared to the corresponding marketed product was conducted on 28 patients with different types of tinea fungal infection.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with different types of tine infection

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant females and patients with Immunocompromising disease, open wounds and psychological disorders were excluded.
